title: Visual Literacy: Advertisements, Cartoons and Film
summary: Analysing persuasive visual texts and moving images: target audience and appeals in advertisements, satire in cartoons, and camera shots, angles, lighting and sound in film.

rows: Emotion: fear, love, nostalgia, guilt, desire
Owning the product makes you superior or successful
Buying helps the environment or a cause

notes.text: Editorial cartoons **satirise** people and institutions through **caricature**, **exaggeration**, **irony**, **symbolism** and **labels**. To analyse one, identify the issue, the target, the techniques and the cartoonist's attitude.

rows: Shows emotion in detail; creates intimacy
Shows the setting; can make a character seem isolated
Makes a character look powerful or threatening
Makes a character seem small or vulnerable
Sound from the story world (dialogue, footsteps)
Added sound (soundtrack, narrator) to build mood

notes.title: Described film still (original)
notes.text: A low-angle shot shows a factory owner standing on a balcony, silhouetted against a red evening sky. Below him, in a high-angle long shot, workers queue at the factory gates. A slow, heavy drumbeat plays on the soundtrack.

notes.label: Exam tip
notes.text: Always link the technique to its effect on the viewer and to the message: 'The low angle makes the owner appear dominant, which emphasises the power imbalance between him and the workers.'

questions.prompt: A low-angle shot usually makes a character appear…
Which type of shot best shows a character's emotion in detail?
A soundtrack added to build tension is…
options: a sound effect in the story world

questions.prompt: Pathos is an appeal to the audience's emotions.
Low-key lighting is typically used to create a cheerful mood.
Match each advert to the appeal it mainly uses.

pairs.left: A doctor recommends a cough syrup
A puppy waits for its owner by the door

questions.prompt: Discuss how camera angles in the described film still show the relationship between the owner and the workers.
questions.memo:
✓ The low angle makes the owner look powerful/dominant (1)
✓ The high-angle long shot makes the workers look small, powerless and numerous (1)
✓ The contrast emphasises inequality/a power imbalance (1)

questions.prompt: What might the red sky and the drumbeat suggest?
questions.memo:
✓ Red suggests danger/anger/conflict (1)
✓ The slow, heavy drumbeat builds tension or a sense of something threatening about to happen (1)

questions.prompt: Why might the director show the owner as a silhouette?
questions.memo:
✓ It hides his face, making him seem mysterious/impersonal (1)
✓ suggesting he is distant from or uncaring towards the workers (1)

questions.prompt: Name FOUR steps for analysing an editorial cartoon.
questions.memo: ✓ Identify the issue ✓ the target ✓ the techniques ✓ the cartoonist's attitude/message (1 each = 4)
